description: A cannon-blast of explosive excitement! A savage, mind-numbingly brutal tale! Issue Zero introduces a deadly new villain who will be playing a major part in the regular series. Buck Wylde is a huge, monstrous, renegade Mountain man who creates bizarre animal traps specifically designed to brutally cripple and maim before they kill. Because he is alone, in the middle of the remote, frontier wilderness, he is free to do anything and everything to his helpless quarry. Then Zorro almost falls victim to one of his hideous snares. From that moment on, Buck Wylde's sadistic bloodsport with wildlife is transformed into a savage blood-combat. To preserve the lifestyle he leads, Buck Wylde must slay Zorro.

Lucien Machete...the Mutilator...do more than remember him. Fear him more than you would the malevolent specter of your worst nightmare. He has kidnapped and is holding for ransom Rosa Madeiros, wife of one of the richest men in Mexico. Rosa Madeiros, a woman of great beauty and greater passions. And because Lucien Machete has discovered the dark secret of her needs, he plans to extort more than mere money from his hostage. It is then that Zorro strikes and cold, sharp blades of steel are drawn, hot, thick blood is spilled...and the earth in violent outrage explodes.

A wounded Zorro struggles to escape a cuartel swarming with soldiers. But unknown to everyone, the alluring and dangerous Lady Rawhide has chosen this night to exact her vengeance against the cruel Capitan Monasterio! When Zorro and Lady Rawhide meet, the two enemies must become allies, which is still no guarantee that this uneasy alliance will save their lives!

A wounded Zorro is held at bay within Capitan Monasterio's treasure room, from which there is only one exit -- the door that is even now being smashed to splinters by Monasterio's soldiers! Monasterio's only regret is that, to be finally rid of the crafty Zorro, his soldiers will be forced to kill the provocatively dressed Lady Rawhide, as well. But what Capitan Monasterio does not know is that Lady Rawhide has harbored her own plans and desires for revenge against Zorro, and, unlike Monasterio, she is inside with a quite vulnerable Zorro! It is then that Machete's own plan of revenge against Zorro takes a sadistic twist!

First appearance of "bad girl" character Lady Rawhide.

Zorro stages a surprise attack on the army compound. His purpose: free an Indian who is being unjustly punished. With a breathtaking series of acrobatics, the rescue is done...right before the army commandante's disbelieving eyes. But Zorro's thrill of victory is broken, then shattered...first by the Indian's bitter ingratitude, and then by a fiery tragedy. Zorro will discover that the Indian he freed is Moonstalker -- the merciless champion of his people. And that the fiery tragedy has inspired the creation of the provocative, deadly Lady Rawhide -- a whip-wielding woman who is determined to see Zorro dead.

issue_title: Men Aren't the Only Ones With Dual Identities
description: Who is Lady Rawhide? What compels her to don her shocking, leather-clad outfit and become a provocative, whip-wielding demoness of the night? And why does she want to kill Zorro? The answers to those questions...and more...are here in the most surprising Zorro adventure yet. Wait'll you see the steamy bedroom scene between Zorro and Lady Rawhide! Capitan Monasterio is not just levying new taxes -- he's brutally extorting outrageous quantities of money and valuables from everyone in and around Los Angeles. In order to discover the reason behind Monasterio's sudden, seemingly arbitrary actions, Zorro is forced to undertake extraordinary risks. Too late, Zorro discovers that these risks have fatally made him the vulnerable prey to the new, merciless, night-stalking interloper who calls herself Lady Rawhide. A soul-wrenching tragedy has set Lady Rawhide on an implacable quest for vengeance...and it looks like Zorro will be her first victim.

issue_title: The Man Who Wasn't Felix Quintero
description: Moonstalker, a California Indian who's watched his people die...who's seen his culture systematically destroyed...is now taking aim at all his enemies. In a lonely section of Pacific coastline, this incredible man has made a weapons factory inside the grisly, gouged-out carcass of a monstrous beached whale. Within this bizarre setting of the decaying innards of the whale's corpse, Moonstalker forges an impressive bow capable of firing multiple-armament arrows, all capable of devastating, explosive potential. When a report of Moonstalker's mysterious activity at the whale's carcass draws Zorro's interest, the dark avenger soon finds himself keeping a rendezvous with certain death when he invades Moonstalker's hideous domain.

issue_title: The Bones Travel to the Ocean
description: As a fierce ocean storm approaches California, Zorro battles for his life against razor-sharp spears, blood-hungry axes and the incredible, deadly explosive weapons of Moonstalker. It is a fight that takes place around, atop, and inside the corpse of a monstrous beached whale. You have to see and read it to believe it. And then there is the haunting double-page spread that reveals the disturbing meaning to this issue's title, a visual motif of dark predators and nightmarish fantasy. Wait till you see Don Diego's newest comic strip parody of Capitan Monasterio and Sergeant Garcia, witness Zorro's father, Don Alejandro's latest reactions to his son's love of a medium of words and pictures.

Zorro in chains! His prison is the gaping maw of a rotting blue whale carcass. And if that wasn't bad enough, a fierce storm is whipping up the waters of the Pacific Ocean, and Zorro is drowning. Also: the return of Lady Rawhide!

Let's kill the corpse? How is that done? The startling answer is revealed in what will most likely be the most important issue to date! All the major characters come together in this suspense-filled, action-packed story. Zorro and Lady Rawhide wrestle in mud! Lady Rawhide kicks Zorro in the face! Moonstalker attacks Monasterio and the mysterious one-handed man! And the identity of the stranger is finally revealed in a scene neither Zorro nor the reader will ever forget!

Zorro is trapped in a brutal, four-way confrontation! The players: Lady Rawhide, Moonstalker, Capitan Monasterio and his soldiers, and, most dangerous of all, an enemy from Zorro's past, the king's regency administrator! It all happens at the moment Moonstalker uses his astonishing explosive arrows to achieve his long sought-after vengeance on Monasterio! As the carnage and conflict escalates, a storm unleashes its full fury...and Lady Rawhide finds herself in the deadly eye of the storm!

Once he was the most feared outlaw leader in all of Mexico. Now, to Zorro's astonishment and horror, Machete is an official representative of the King of Spain -- his regency administrator! Zorro becomes witness and pawn in the unfolding of Machete's sinister plan to destroy him! Plus: appearances by Lady Rawhide, Carmelita Rodriguez and the Mutilator!

The Rime of the Ancient Mariner

description: The fan favorite team of writer Paul Jenkins and artist Humberto Ramos reteam for the newest ongoing series starring the Amazing Spider-Man. And the series kicks off with a bang, as Spidey faces off against his deadliest foe, Venom!
"COUNTDOWN" Concludes (5/5)! Spidey & Doc Ock face off in a titanic, action-packed throwdown! But will the wall-crawler be forced to disclose his true identity in order to preserve world peace?

He's struggled for years to control the coiled reptile that dwells deep within his heart. But now, at the end of his rope, one bad day with change Dr. Curt Connors' life forever - and the Lizard will stalk the streets once more!
Return of the Lizard! Spidey squares off against a tortured friend and colleague.

"THE LIZARD's TALE" pt. 3 (of 3)?As Curt Connors' self-destructive behavior escalates, Spidey must try to corral his out-of-control friend. But the Lizard may force the wall-crawler to kill, rather than cure!

A special fully painted stand-alone story! On a rooftop in the Bronx sits a sad handicapped man. A prisoner of his own crippled body, how will a battle between the wall-crawler and Morbius, the Living Vampire, change his life?

The web-slinger is confronted by an all-new menace -- one whose very presence causes his spider-sense to go bananas! Can even guest-star Captain America help turn the tide against this soldier from a different age? AND HOW WILL THESE EVENTS AFFECT THIS SUMMER'S AVENGERS EPIC, BEGINNING NEXT MONTH IN AVENGERS #500?

The web-slinger is confronted by an all-new menace -- one whose very presence causes his spider-sense to go bananas! Can even guest-star Captain America help turn the tide against this soldier from a different age? AND HOW WILL THESE EVENTS AFFECT THIS SUMMER'S AVENGERS EPIC, BEGINNING NEXT MONTH IN AVENGERS #500?

AVENGERS DISASSEMBLED TIE-IN! Spidey's life is thrown into turmoil as he begins to undergo a shocking transformation--one that may well leave the web-slinger scarred forever! What is the cause of this strange mutation--and how does it connect to the troubles plaguing the Avengers?

Overview His humanity slipping away from him, a danger to his friends and loved ones, Spidey grapples with the amazing transformation that's taken hold of him--while, in the depths of the world, the Queen awaits…

Betrayed by his body and suffering the painful effects of his slow transformation from man to arachnid, Spidey must once again confront the architect of his metamorphosis - the Queen! But only Captain America holds the key to her defeat!!
Spidey faces off against his deadliest foe, Venom!

AVENGERS DISASSEMBLED TIE-IN! PART 4 (OF 4) At his lowest ebb, struggling to hold onto the last vestige of the humanity buried deep inside him, Spidey is lent a helping hand by one of Earth's Mightiest Heroes!

GUEST-STARRING THE FANTASTIC FOUR, DOCTOR STRANGE, THE BLACK CAT AND THE ANGEL! Ben Grimm's all-night poker games have become legendary among the super hero set, and for the first time Spider-Man has been asked to join the table! But when the Kingpin unexpectedly deals himself in, the stakes are raised! Can the wall-crawler come out on top in this celebrity poker showdown?

Once he was the Mindworm, a nemesis of Spider-Man! But now he's a lonely, forlorn beggar, trapped in an infernal triangle of poverty, booze and dementia. How can Peter Parker help his one-time foe--and is Spidey himself responsible for his pitiable condition?

"Sins Remembered" Part 1 of 4. Spinning directly out of the events of "Sins Past" in Amazing Spider-Man, Spider-Man and Sarah, the daughter of Gwen Stacy and the web-slinger's greatest enemy, embark on a journey of discovery--one that will take them halfway around the world to Paris, and into the sights of a mysterious new enemy.

"Sins Remembered" Part 2 of 4. Spinning directly out of the events of "Sins Past" in Amazing Spider-Man, Spider-Man and Sarah, the daughter of Gwen Stacy and the web-slinger's greatest enemy, embark on a journey of discovery--one that will take them halfway around the world to Paris, and into the sights of a mysterious new enemy.
"SINS REMEMBERED: Sarah's Story" The most talked about Spider-Man story of the year continues, as the offspring of Gwen Stacy puts the moves on Peter Parker! Part 3 (of 4).
Peter learns the truth about Gwen Stacy's daughter Sarah as a deadly enemy strikes! This is what it’s all been building to, folks!! Part 4 (of 4).
Paul Jenkins wraps up his five-year tenure as a Spider-Man writer and brings SPECTACULAR SPIDER-MAN to a close in a moving, self-contained tale that reunites him with artist Mark Buckingham.
Spidey plays detective and tries to uncover the connection between Venom and his latest victims! Part 3 of the debut 5-issue story arc!
Still reeling from his last encounter with Venom, Spider-Man seeks out the help of the FANTASTIC FOUR.

Eddie Brock is dying. His cancer has caught up to him and Venom has finally lost his ideal host. As Spidey tries to understand why Eddie has hated him all these years, he's forced to make an ultimate decision... Should Spidey save Eddie's life - allowing Venom to live?
"COUNTDOWN" pts. 1 (of 5)-Doc Ock is out to destroy Spider-Man once and for all but this time he's doing it in style. Check out Humberto Ramos' cool new redesign of Spider-Man's most devious villain.
COUNTDOWN PART 2 Check out Humberto Ramos' cool new redesign of Spider-Man's most devious villain, Doc Ock!

"COUNTDOWN" pt. 3 (of 5)?Doctor Octopus is out to ruin Spider-Man once and for all and has given the wall-crawler an ultimatum. For the safe release of the Palestinian ambassador, Spider-Man must reveal his identity to the entire world!
"COUNTDOWN" pt. 4 (of 5) It's High Noon in Times Square as a defeated Spider- Man confronts Doc Ock, with countless innocent lives hanging in the balance!
